name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-google-tagmanager
title: Google Tag Manager MCP
description: MCP server for the Google Tag Manager API v2: containers, workspaces, tags, triggers, publishing.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TAGMANAGER_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth client secret (refresh-token flow). Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TAGMANAGER_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth refresh token; exchanged for access tokens automatically. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TAGMANAGER_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Ready-made OAuth access token (~1h lifetime). Alternative to the client-id/secret/refresh-token trio.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TAGMANAGER_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429, quota 403, and 5xx/network for reads).

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TAGMANAGER_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum spacing between API requests, for the 0.25 QPS quota.
